title: Minor : About/ Show NS version
body:
Actually, in the _About_ window, NS version is only shown if AAPS is connected to NS at the same time. 

If NS connection is set to "connect when charging" in AAPS, even if the phone was charging 5 minutes ago (but is no more), the About screen forgets the NS version.

As NS version changes very rarely, it would be nice if the About window shoved the last NS version AAPS had detected.
